en.headline: Suspended police officer appears in court over alleged HK$4.2 million mortgage fraud
en.dek: A 32-year-old officer attached to Kwai Tsing district faces two counts of fraud after allegedly submitting false documents to a bank in 2021.
body: A 32-year-old police officer appeared in Sha Tin Magistrates’ Courts on Tuesday charged with two counts of fraud. Police said the man, who has been suspended from duty, was arrested on 18 August by officers from New Territories South Regional Crime Unit.
Investigators alleged that in 2021 the officer provided false documents and information to a local bank to obtain mortgage loans totalling about HK$4.2 million. He is attached to Kwai Tsing district.
Police emphasised that the Force takes a zero-tolerance approach to misconduct by its members and will handle any illegal acts by officers strictly.

zh.headline: 男警涉虛假文件申420萬按揭貸款 今沙田提堂
zh.dek: 32歲葵青警區男警被控兩項欺詐罪，指他於2021年向銀行提供虛假文件及資料騙取約420萬元按揭貸款。
body: 一名32歲男警務人員今日在沙田裁判法院提堂，被控兩項欺詐罪。新界南總區重案組人員上周二（18日）拘捕該名男警，他現已被停職。
警方調查顯示，該男警於2021年向一間本地銀行提供虛假文件及資料，以獲取共約420萬元的按揭貸款。據了解，他隸屬葵青警區。
警方強調，警隊非常重視人員操守，任何人員干犯違法行為，絕不容忍和姑息，定必嚴正處理。
